title: Helios Towers and UNICEF Sign Multi-Year Partnership to Expand School Connectivity in Africa
detail: Helios Towers and UNICEF signed a multi-year partnership on September 29, 2026 to expand internet connectivity and digital learning access for children and young people across Africa, supporting UNICEF's Giga (a UNICEF–ITU initiative to connect every school by 2030) and Learning Passport (online/offline learning platform) programmes. Helios Towers will support school connectivity mapping and infrastructure development, initially in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Malawi and Tanzania, with a West African country to follow.
